original_evidence.text: | sing-box — **Windows desktop daemon self-update** | https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box | 2b12b99 / 2026-08-19 | Y | N (triggered via local gRPC/UI action; installer path handed to daemon, download step itself not in this repo) | Y | n/a for this repo (installer already on disk when handed to daemon) | Y (Authenticode) | signature (Authenticode via `WinVerifyTrust`) + **signer-continuity pinning**: extracted signer cert bytes must equal the signer of the *currently running* daemon | OS keystore (Authenticode/WinTrust chain) **plus** self-referential pin (`daemonSigner` read from the running trusted binary at startup, not literally hardcoded) | `experimental/boxdd/update_windows.go:29-90` (`installUpdate`: NSIS structural check + Authenticode signer compared via `bytes.Equal(installerSigner, platform.daemonSigner)`), `experimental/boxdd/authenticode_windows.go:28-84` (`authenticodeSigner` uses real `WinVerifyTrustEx`), `experimental/boxdd/peer_windows.go:58-64` (`daemonSigner` derived from own running executable's Authenticode cert) |

| sing-box — **rule-set auto-updater** (data channel, noted per instructions) | (same repo) | | Y | Y (interval-based) | N (loaded as routing rules, not executed code) | https by default via generic `httpClientManager` (standard Go TLS, no InsecureSkipVerify found for this path; `InsecureSkipVerify` hits elsewhere in repo are for user-configured outbound proxy TLS, e.g. REALITY, unrelated) | N | none (routing rule data) | n/a | `route/rule/rule_set_updater.go:1-80` (loop updater), `route/rule/rule_set_remote.go:44-98,291-312` (http.Client via resolveTransport) |

| sing-box — **external UI (Yacd-meta dashboard) downloader**, content-as-code side channel (C-equivalent) | (same repo) | | Y | Y (auto on first run if dir empty) or via clash-API `POST /upgrade/ui` | Y (downloads and serves a JS/HTML dashboard bundle) | https, TLS validated (`RootCAs: adapter.RootPoolFromContext`, no InsecureSkipVerify) | N | none | server-supplied / unpinned (no hash/signature check of the zip at all) | `experimental/clashapi/server_resources.go:22-83` (`downloadExternalUI`, default `https://github.com/MetaCubeX/Yacd-meta/archive/gh-pages.zip`, straight `zip.OpenReader` extraction with zero verification), `experimental/clashapi/api_meta_upgrade.go:1-32` (`/upgrade/ui` endpoint) |
